title: rorca-live-spec-terminal
_philosophy: Spec generation is a 30-90 second black box. Users don't need a full terminal (that's what Runs are for) — they need transparency: what context was injected, real progress, and clear errors when things fail. A context summary card before generation + an honest progress bar during + actionable error detail after is worth more than a streaming terminal for a sub-minute operation.

userStories.title: Context Injection Summary — Show What's Being Sent to the LLM
userStories.description: Before the LLM call starts, show the user exactly what context is being injected into the spec generation prompt. Display a structured summary card showing direction stack layers, skills, memory entries, and template context. This makes spec generation transparent and debuggable — users can see if context is wrong BEFORE waiting 60 seconds for a bad spec.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/specs/generate response now includes a `contextSummary` object alongside the generated spec

contextSummary shape: { directionLayers: { l1: boolean, l2: { present: boolean, domain: string | null }, l3: boolean }, skills: string[], memoryEntries: number, agentsMd: boolean, template: string | null, schemaSnapshot: boolean, gitMemory: boolean, estimatedTokens: number, modelContextWindow: number }
Data sourced from the existing synthesizeWithMeta() result + buildCatalogContext() already computed in the generate handler — no extra DB queries or LLM calls
estimatedTokens computed as: total prompt text length / 4 (same ~±10% estimation used by context-router.ts)
modelContextWindow resolved from the SUPPORTED_MODELS list for the selected model
Frontend renders context summary card ABOVE the progress bar when generation starts

Card layout: compact horizontal badges — 'L1 ✓ L2 ✓ L3 ✓' direction status, 'Skills: react, tailwind' list, 'Memory: 12 entries' count, 'Template: none' or template name, token estimate as '{N}K / {M}K tokens ({P}%)'
Token usage bar: thin accent-colored progress bar showing estimated tokens vs model context window
Warning state: if estimated tokens > 50% of context window, bar turns amber with tooltip 'High context usage — spec quality may degrade'
Critical state: if estimated tokens > 80% of context window, bar turns red with tooltip 'Context near limit — consider reducing direction stack or skills'
Card persists after generation completes — visible in the spec result view so users can correlate context with output quality
Card is collapsible (chevron toggle) — expanded by default during generation, collapsed after completion
Accessible: aria-label on card, color-blind safe (icons + color, not color alone)

userStories.title: Real Progress Bar — Replace Simulated Stages with Actual Elapsed Time
userStories.description: Replace the fake timer-based stage transitions in SpecForgeProgress with real data. Show the actual model being used, real elapsed time, and derive stage from backend events instead of setTimeout advancing through stages on a fixed schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: SpecForgeProgress component receives new props: { model: string, provider: string, contextSummary: ContextSummary }
Model badge displayed at the top of the progress bar: model name + provider icon (same style as spec card badges)
Elapsed time counter shows REAL wall clock time since generation started (already implemented via startTimeRef — ensure it's displayed prominently, not just in stage rows)

Single-pass stages derived from actual backend signals instead of setTimeout: Stage 1 'Assembling Context' shown immediately (0ms), Stage 2 'Calling {model}...' shown when POST returns (context assembly is synchronous), Stage 3 'Generating Stories' shown 2s after POST returns (LLM is processing), Stage 4 'Validating Output' shown when response arrives but before JSON parsing completes
Multi-pass stages remain SSE-driven (spec_generation_pass events) — no change needed, they're already real
Remove STAGE_TRANSITIONS constant (the fake delays: { analyzing: 0, context: 2500, generating: 6000, validating: 0 })
Stage 3 'Generating Stories' shows a subtle animated gradient bar (indeterminate progress — we don't know when the LLM will respond)
If generation takes > 90 seconds: show reassurance text 'Complex specs take longer — still working...' below the progress bar
If generation takes > 180 seconds: show amber text 'This is taking unusually long. You can cancel and retry with a simpler brief.'
Stage completion times shown as actual durations (already in elapsed state — just ensure they're real, not simulated)

userStories.title: Actionable Error Detail — Show Why Generation Failed
userStories.description: When spec generation fails, show a structured error panel with the actual error message, the model/provider that failed, and actionable suggestions for how to fix it. Replace the generic 'Generation failed' message with specific, debuggable information.
acceptanceCriteria: SpecForgeProgress error state redesigned from single red box to structured error card
Error card shows: error category header (bold), raw error message (monospace, scrollable if long), model and provider that was used, context summary that was injected (same card from LST-001)

Error categories with specific icons and suggestions: 'Model Error' (model icon) — wrong model name, unsupported provider → 'Check model name in Settings > Providers', 'API Key Error' (key icon) — invalid/expired API key → 'Update your API key in Settings > Providers > API Keys', 'Rate Limit' (clock icon) — provider throttling → 'Wait {N} seconds or switch to a different model', 'Context Too Large' (overflow icon) — prompt exceeds context window → 'Reduce direction stack or remove skills. Current: {N}K tokens, max: {M}K', 'Timeout' (hourglass icon) — LLM took too long → 'Try a faster model or reduce story count', 'Parse Error' (code icon) — LLM returned invalid JSON → 'The model produced unparseable output. Try again or switch models', 'Network Error' (wifi-off icon) — connectivity issue → 'Check your internet connection and API endpoint', 'Unknown' (warning icon) — catch-all → raw error message
Error categorization logic in backend: parse error message / HTTP status code from LLM provider response into category enum before sending to frontend

POST /api/specs/generate error response shape changes from { error: string } to { error: string, category: ErrorCategory, model: string, provider: string, contextSummary: ContextSummary, suggestion: string }
Retry button in error card: 'Retry with same settings' (re-submits identical request) and 'Retry with different model' (opens model picker inline)
Error card includes 'Copy error details' button — copies formatted error to clipboard for bug reports
If error is 'Parse Error': show the raw LLM response (first 500 chars) in a collapsible section so users can see what the model actually returned

userStories.title: Generation Log Persistence — Store Context + Outcome per Spec
userStories.description: Persist the context summary and generation outcome (success/failure, duration, token usage) to the database so it's viewable from the spec detail slide-over after the fact. When reviewing a spec, users can see what context produced it.
acceptanceCriteria: New table: spec_generation_logs (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, spec_slug TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT, duration_ms INTEGER, input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, context_summary TEXT NOT NULL, error TEXT, error_category TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
Migration file: backend/src/db/migrations/037-spec-generation-logs.sql
context_summary stored as JSON string (the same ContextSummary object from LST-001)
Row inserted on generation completion (success or failure) in the POST /api/specs/generate handler
GET /api/specs/:id/generation-log returns the most recent generation log for this spec slug
If spec was regenerated (add-stories or re-forge): multiple rows exist, endpoint returns most recent, with ?all=true option to get full history
SpecDetailSlideOver: new 'Context' tab (between 'History' and 'JSON') showing the generation log
Context tab renders: the same context summary card from LST-001 (reused component), model + provider + duration + token usage stats, error detail if generation failed before succeeding
If no generation log exists: tab shows 'No generation data available' with muted text
Token usage shown as: 'Input: {N}K tokens | Output: {M}K tokens | Cost: ~${C}' (cost estimated from model pricing if available, otherwise hidden)
Generation logs cleaned up when spec is deleted (foreign key or manual DELETE in spec deletion handler)
